event: The last thing you remember is your back window, a book on your knee, your eyes getting heavy.

memory.fact: The last thing Alan remembers is dozing over a book at his back window one evening.

event: Cold water runs over your fingers; you wake on smooth grey stones by a clear, cold stream.

memory.fact: Nala woke on the bank at Greyfen Ford in the mid-morning of day one.
The streambed at the ford is laid with flat grey stones.

event: You sit up, and your body is wrong: thin arms, small pale freckled hands, long dark red hair.

memory.fact: Her skin is pale and fair, with freckles across her nose and cheeks.
Her hair is long, heavy and dark red, falling past her shoulder blades.

event: Your old grey shirt hangs off you, your black tights are still on, and your feet are bare and small.

changes.note: Alan's grey shirt came through with Nala, and she wears it
Alan's black tights came through with Nala, and she wears them

memory.fact: She wears Alan's loose dark grey shirt, which hangs to her mid-thigh and gapes at the collar.
She wears Alan's black compression tights, which still fit her snugly.
She has no shoes, no money, no papers and nothing in her hands.

event: A cart track comes down out of tall dark pines, crosses the stream here, and climbs to a grey ridge.

memory.fact: Greyfen Ford is a shallow stone ford where a forest cart track crosses a clear, cold stream.
Tall dark pines crowd both banks, and the far bank climbs to a ridge of bare grey rock.

event: The mud is printed with wheel ruts, heavy hooves, and paw prints wider than your hand.

memory.fact: Wheel ruts and the prints of hooves and large paws mark the mud at the water's edge.

event: Beyond the ridge, thin chimney smoke goes up into a pale morning sky.

memory.fact: Thin chimney smoke rises beyond the ridge to the east, perhaps an hour's walk away.
The ridge and the chimney smoke lie across the stream to the east, beyond the far bank.

event: Blue letters open in the air: [New Species Integration: Human] [Level 1]. They turn with your head.

memory.fact: Blue System letters told Nala her species integration is Human and she is Level 1.
Nala sees System messages as steady blue letters in the air that turn with her head.
System messages come as a voice in the mind and as floating blue screens before the eyes.

event: Behind your breastbone sits a pressure like a held breath, patient and vast; it notices you back.

memory.fact: Behind her breastbone Nala feels a vast, patient pressure that notices her back.

event: Somewhere up the track, a branch snaps under something big.

memory.fact: The branch that snapped up the track snapped under Sootjaw.

event: "Okay, Isekai protocol. Status? System?" You push at the letters, and a larger blue screen opens.
[Status: Name ???, Species Human, Level 1, Class: None]

memory.fact: Asked for status, the System shows her a blue screen: Name ???, Species Human, Level 1.
Her status shows Class: None.

event: [Stats: Strength 8, Dexterity 10, Vigor 9, Attunement 30, Luck 12]

memory.fact: Her stats read Strength 8, Dexterity 10, Vigor 9, Attunement 30, Luck 12.

event: [Vitals: Health 40/40, Mana 120/120, Stamina 30/30]

memory.fact: Her vitals read Health 40/40, Mana 120/120, Stamina 30/30.

event: [Reserves: Earth 20/20, Fire 20/20, Wind 20/20, Water 20/20, Electricity 20/20]

memory.fact: Her status lists five reserves, Earth, Fire, Wind, Water and Electricity, each at 20/20.

event: The Skills line stops at its colon; one line sits apart: [Legacy: ???]

memory.fact: Her status lists no skills, and one line that reads only: Legacy: ???
Her legacy line and its skill stay ??? until she first draws on the pressure in her chest.

event: [Unrecognized request. Please see the help menu for available functions.]

memory.fact: Odd requests get "[Unrecognized request. Please see the help menu for available functions.]"

event: Attunement is more than double anything else; your Mana is triple your Health.
At the Legacy line the pressure stirs; you push at the question marks, and they stay blank.

memory.fact: The pressure in her chest stirs when she looks at her Legacy line; pushing at it shows nothing.

event: Overhead the morning sky is a pale red, and the sun in it is small and white.

memory.fact: The morning sky over the ford is a pale red, with a small white sun.

event: A shaggy black beast the size of a small bear shoulders out of the pines above the ford.

memory.fact: It is a shaggy black four-legged beast the size of a small bear, thick-necked and heavy-boned.
Its muzzle is soot-black, and its short snout is crowded with pointed teeth.
Its forepaws are as wide as the big paw prints in the mud at Greyfen Ford.

event: Twenty yards off across the shallows it sees you, lowers its head and hisses like a huge cat.

memory.fact: On day one it came down the ridge track to the ford, saw Nala across it, and hissed like a cat.
Its short snout is crowded with pointed teeth, and it hisses like a cat before it charges.

event: "Oh, perfect! A test subject!" You point a finger and will a narrow beam of flame through it.
The pressure answers at once; a thin line of white-gold fire leaps from your fingertip.

changes.note: Her first fire beam spends a Surge's 10 mana
Her first fire beam spends 1 fire from the reserve

memory.fact: The legacy answers when she reaches for that pressure with intent: to strike, shield or move.
The pressure behind her breastbone is the Starfall Legacy, waiting to be drawn on.

event: The beam punches into the beast's chest and out its back; its dry fur catches, and it shrieks.

memory.fact: Nala's beam burned a neat round hole clean through Sootjaw, chest to back.
Its hide gives no ward against fire, and its dry, matted fur catches and burns.

event: It lurches two steps into the shallows and collapses in a boil of steam and smoke.

memory.fact: On day one Nala burned it through the chest with a beam of fire, and it died in the ford.

event: Your fingertip is unmarked and barely warm; a small hollow behind your breastbone fills back in.

memory.fact: Fire loosed from her fingertip leaves the fingertip unmarked and barely warm.
Loosing fire leaves a small hollow behind her breastbone that fills back in on its own.

event: [Legacy: Starfall] [New active skill obtained: Starfall Surge]

changes.note: Her first draw opens the Starfall Legacy to her at rank 1
At rank 1 each of her element reserves holds 20
At rank 1 she can hold two workings at once
The System grants Starfall Surge at level 1 with her first draw

memory.fact: Her first draw on the pressure opens the status line to read [Legacy: Starfall].
With that first draw the System shows [New active skill obtained: Starfall Surge].

event: [Starfall Surge: raw element loosed from the reserves as a blast, a ward or a burst of speed.]

memory.fact: The System names Starfall Surge as raw element loosed as a blast, a ward or a burst of speed.

event: [Prey Eliminated!] [Experience Gained!]

changes.note: Killing the Brute earns her first marks toward the next level

memory.fact: Beasts killed read "Prey Eliminated!"; thinking foes such as humans read "Foe Eliminated!"
After a kill line comes "Experience Gained!" or "No Experience Awarded."

event: [You have leveled up!] [You are now level 2!]

changes.note: The Brute's kill raises Nala to Level 2

memory.fact: A level-up reads "You have leveled up!", then "You are now level 22!", then lines like "+9 Vigor".

event: [+2 Strength] [+2 Dexterity] [+2 Vigor] [+4 Attunement] [+1 Luck]

changes.note: Level 2 grants +2 Strength
Level 2 grants +2 Dexterity
Level 2 grants +2 Vigor
Level 2 grants +4 Attunement
Level 2 grants +1 Luck
Level 2 lifts her greatest health by 5
The level-up fills the new health
Attunement 34 lifts her greatest mana to four times it
The level-up adds the 16 new mana to what she held
Vigor 11 lifts her greatest stamina to 36
The level-up fills the new stamina

event: A warm rush runs through your body as the lines come up, and you feel steadier. Sharper.

memory.fact: Her level-up stat gains came with a warm rush through her body, leaving her steadier and sharper.

event: The beast lies still in the far shallows, smoke drifting off its burnt fur.

memory.fact: Its carcass still smokes in the shallows of Greyfen Ford after Nala's kill.
